title: Roles and permissions
subtitle: Manage tenant roles, permission points and effective-dated organisational responsibilities.
roleCreateDescription: Create a tenant role and decide whether the organization chart limits its scope.
discardDescription: Your role details will be lost if you close now.
permissionDiscardDescription: Unsaved changes to this permission matrix will be lost if you close now.
roleOrganizationScoped: This role is department-scoped and receives data access through the organization chart.
selectRole: Select a tenant role to manage its permissions.
coverageExplanation: Assigned permission points compared with all permission points in this area.
overviewSubtitle: Compare how roles cover functional areas at a glance. Select a cell to inspect that role.
scopeNotice: This map shows permission points. Actual access also requires valid tenant, administration and organization scope on the effective date.
assignmentSubtitle: Record where someone works and who holds a management role within a department. Together with permission points, these assignments determine final access.
failed: The change could not be saved.
selfAuthorizationLockout: This change would remove your own access to Roles and permissions. Keep read and manage access on this active role first.
roleAssignmentsSubtitle: Assign manager and custom roles. Department and job are managed exclusively through employment.
roleAssignmentsScopeRequired: This role only grants access within the selected department.
roleAssignmentsFailed: The role assignment could not be saved.
roleAssignmentsWriteRequired: You do not have permission to change role assignments.
roleAssignmentsNoCurrentAssignments: This department has no current role holders.
